gen-gf-tektur-gf-chocolate-classical-san: Wiry, oversized, a bit techno: Tektur draws every stroke with one fixed nib width. Chocolate Classical Sans follows with a broad-nibbed pen stroke and a sizable lowercase that keeps long paragraphs feeling modern and easy to move through.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, with no clogged curves and lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height. Tektur's wiry, outsized display shapes make it the livelier half.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-cossette-texte: Wiry and oversized up top, then a wide-eyed lowercase e and a prominent x-height in Cossette Texte below. Tektur supplies the spark.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans keeps its small letters wide open. Tektur's spaghetti-like strokes, all one width, give the headline a strange energy, while the body's dominant lowercase keeps ascenders barely visible and lines tidy.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-fresca: Tektur's curves all end in generous openings. Shrink it down and those pipe-cleaner strokes lose their charm, while Fresca, a sans-serif with short ascenders above big bowls, can handle larger sizes without losing its connected counters.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-funnel-sans: Tektur's outsized lowercase and pipe-cleaner strokes make the heading feel almost built from wire, with openings on every curve. Funnel Sans, a sans-serif, holds its stroke widths steady beneath.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-gafata: Tektur's hairline-free, swell-free letterforms look wiry and oversized. Gafata does the quieter job well, a tall band of lowercase with short stalks and wide-eyed e shapes that stay readable, where Tektur mostly turns heads.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, its words forming solid blocks rather than skylines with no accents of weight. Tektur is the one that performs, while Geist simply carries the text.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-georama: Tektur's single-width stroke in every glyph gives it a wiry, oversized personality. Georama's wide-open c and barely rising capitals make a gentle, approachable counterweight to that jolt.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-gidole: Gidole draws every stroke with neon-tube consistency, its terminals staying apart like open scissor blades. And Tektur, with its wiry outsized lowercase, gives that tidy body a distinctive, expressive headline to sit under.
